n=22
g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
def put(r,c,v):
    assert 0<=r<n and 0<=c<n,(r,c,v)
    assert g[r][c] in (0,v), (r,c,g[r][c],v)
    g[r][c]=v
# fixed 4 center
for r in range(10,13):
    for c in range(8,11): put(r,c,4)
# translated color 6 (+5,+5), from test input
for r,c in [(2,c) for c in range(4,9)]+[(3,4),(3,8),(4,8),(5,8),(6,7),(6,8)]:
    put(r+5,c+5,6)
# translated color 5 (-9,-1)
for r,c in [(16,c) for c in range(16,19)]+[(17,18)]+[(18,c) for c in range(16,19)]:
    put(r-9,c-1,5)
# translated color 3 (-4,+3)
for r,c in [(16,9),(16,10),(17,10),(18,6),(18,10)]+[(19,c) for c in range(6,11)]:
    put(r-4,c+3,3)
# translated color 1 (+3,+13)
for r,c in [(9,2),(9,3),(10,3),(11,3),(12,2),(12,3)]:
    put(r+3,c+13,1)
# marker pixels translated with each shape / fixed 4; overlap permitted
markers=[(9,9),(11,11),(12,11),(13,9)]
markers += [(2+5,9+5),(4+5,4+5),(4+5,9+5),(6+5,6+5)]
markers += [(16-9,15-1),(18-9,15-1)]
markers += [(16-4,8+3),(16-4,11+3),(17-4,6+3),(19-4,11+3)]
markers += [(9+3,1+13),(12+3,1+13)]
for r,c in markers: put(r,c,2)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in g))
print('nonzero',sum(v!=0 for row in g for v in row),'markers',markers)
